specification_compliance: I1/I8: manifest.json no longer has a drive-home-sections key, and slots.ts no longer maps 'pickup' to PickupWidget, so intelligence gives the drive-home-sections slot nothing. retirePickup.driveHome.test.tsx renders AddonSlot from the real manifest entries and expects innerHTML to be empty, with and without a profile.
I2: no remaining component calls the Pickup API from the drive home. The only callers of fetchPickup and readPickupPage left in api.ts serve the Recommended providers.

I3: pages/pickup.tsx is deleted. The subpage route imports pages/${slug} dynamically (page.tsx:22), so 'pickup' now reaches the same notFound as an unknown slug. page.retirePickup.test.tsx checks this.
I4/I6: slotProviders.pickup and slotPageProviders.pickup (pickupShelfProvider and pickupPageProvider) and the manifest entry for video-discover-recommended are unchanged.
I5/I9: slotItemActions.pickup is unchanged. intelligence.pickup.notInterested and notInterestedToast remain in both en.json and ja.json (lines 37-38).
I7: the diff touches no backend code, worker or DB.
The repository has no remaining reference to PickupWidget, drive.pickup or the removed pickup.heading, description, empty, loading or retry keys, outside historical specs and review records.
The touch-point list covers every product path in the diff. The only unlisted paths are two new test files, reported as TP-1 and TP-2.
potential_unspecified_behavior: On a drive where the video app is hidden, the viewer has no way left to see Pickup. The spec accepts this under 'Checked, no action'.
regression_risks: If another addon later adds a drive-home-sections entry, the hard-coded DRIVE_HOME_GLYPHS = 4 in section-headings.test.ts only counts core files, so it stays correct.

The intelligence submodule's test suite depends on cwd: ADDON_ROOT in retirePickup.driveHome.test.tsx tries ../addons/intelligence and then addons/intelligence. If neither path exists, the non-null assertion makes the test fail loudly rather than pass silently.
test_coverage: I1, I2 and I8 are covered by retirePickup.driveHome.test.tsx, which reads the real manifest. Re-adding the manifest entry and the slots.ts mapping would make it fail.
I3 is covered by page.retirePickup.test.tsx. Restoring pages/pickup.tsx would make it fail, because notFound would never be called and waitFor would time out.
The retireFind test now uses search-compare, which exists, and also asserts that no error was caught.
I4, I5, I6 and I9 get no new tests in this diff. The spec relies on the existing tests for pickupShelfProvider, pickupPageProvider and pickupNotInterestedAction, which I did not read.
Deleting the two notInterested tests removes the SPEC-ADDON-154 coverage for the home row and for the Pickup page. The surfaces they tested are gone.
not_verified: I did not run any test, because the tools here are read-only.
I did not read the existing Recommended provider tests or the item-action tests that I4, I5, I6 and I9 rely on.
I did not check that AddonSlot leaves no wrapper element in the DriveHome layout when the slot is empty (I8 in the real DriveHome.tsx).
I did not inspect the backend or DB code for I7, though the diff touches neither.
